marketplace.summary: A premium charity, NGO, and civic theme that moves visitors from your mission to a clear support action — donate, volunteer, or follow — with impact proof, live campaign progress, and transparent annual-report sections built in.
marketplace.description: Theme Nonprofit gives charities, NGOs, and civic organisations a calm, trust-building front end engineered around the supporter journey: a campaign-led hero, impact evidence, donation and volunteer paths, events, community stories, and transparency/annual-report sections. It ships as a Capell theme with accessible defaults (skip link, focus-visible outlines, semantic sections) and a route-backed demo you can install in one command to preview a complete cause site. Sections light up automatically when you add Capell Payments (donations), Campaign Studio (live appeals), Events, Blog, and Form Builder — no template surgery required. Premium, first-party, and priority-supported for teams who need a public site that converts interest into sustained giving.
